structural_change: k7 (H-SU 2026-10-16): k6 hbm_sfucore_split-k6-dea957e63 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN bank_distance (lanes 0/3/6/12.. 502 um from their E-face pins: only one lane column can sit within 100 um of one face) + TEXTBOOK REFUSE clk 18,143 sinks / rst_n 13,745 loads. Fix: ot_hgi_sfu_core_split2 splits the lane-direct buses W (lanes 0-7) / E (8-15) so each lane column hugs its own face; pin regs on their own roots clk_pw (W ~4.4k) / clk_pe (E ~2.7k), clk keeps bridge+engine (~10.9k); rst_n -> ot_rst_relay (4 regions). Floorplan: lane columns R0 W / MY E at 32.4 um from the faces, 352.08 pitch (21.6 um row gaps), 80 SRAMs abutted in the middle column (x 295.488), local_* W and io/ctl E moved above the lane field (2838.8..3560). Same outline 763.56 x 3580.
